title: internal/cli tests claim runs without redirecting TICFAC_REGISTRY_DIR, writing test registrations into the operator's real ~/.ticfac/registry
description:
internal/cli's status tests call runlife.Claim for run ids like r-status and r-sigterm from per-test temp checkouts but never redirect the registry directory, so every gate and CI run leaves registrations in the operator's real ~/.ticfac/registry pointing at deleted temp dirs (verified: r-status.json, r-1.json, r-sigterm.json present after the gate run). runlife's own TestMain redirects the registry for exactly this reason ('a test that claims a run must not write on the machine that runs it'); aj9's registration made cli claims writes, and 9oo's refusal now makes those stray registrations load-bearing for cli test claims. A package TestMain redirecting runregistry.RegistryDirEnv in internal/cli fixes it.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding ffcf041e457da2d27c37ee2a64907547eed5cc6aed94382a86e992ea6a0c2b2c (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-9oo/attempt-15): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates the done, naming no single item (the fallback names every item at risk in its reason). The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/ffcf041e457da2d27c37ee2a64907547eed5cc6aed94382a86e992ea6a0c2b2c.json on the run branch.
